column1: # Reading fetched: rid is reported if among the names separated by «,» there is rid or SaidID(rid) (P/03.4 Н1.1 `said_id` read). The form — the README beside.

column5: the name is compared whole, not as a prefix
an empty fetched — nothing is reported
an empty element — not a name, the rest are read
spaces are not removed: « cmd-2» — not cmd-2 (the writer writes without spaces)
the reader accepts rid itself too, not only SaidID
a rid with a comma is not read by itself: split into a and b
a rid with a comma — by SaidID
